criteria.evidence: Purdue ArcGIS feature 235 names Matthews Hall (MTHW); 14 source-ring edges independently match the reopened grade-level mesh within 0.002 m.

Absolute source/model XY edge coordinates agree; this jointly checks campus position, plan orientation/shape, and structural plan dimensions. Coordinate evidence is the project's approximate local transform, not survey-grade.

Official Purdue emergency plan states three stories, and the official exterior image supports a shallow roof edge. Reopened mesh has three visible facade tiers and roof top at 11.95 m. No measured elevation or floor heights are available; GIS level count conflicts (4) and GIS extrusion field is undocumented, so exact height is unverified.

Direct visual comparison of saved preview with official Purdue Events photo supports red brick, pale horizontal stone courses, repeated sash-window rhythm, and a columned south-front portico/entrance. Only an oblique view of one facade is available; exact window dimensions, side/rear facades, material extent, and entrance bearing remain unverified.

criteria.criterion: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Reopened file contains the expected single mesh in the named manifest collection/path; no linked file images; source snapshots, metadata, preview, and reopen record are present.

findings: Structural footprint, position, orientation, and plan dimensions independently match the named official GIS feature.
Three stories are supported by an official emergency plan, but the model's 11.95 m roof height is an estimate without elevation evidence; GIS records conflict on floor count.
Facade reconstruction has good qualitative support on the photographed frontage; other elevations and precise architectural measurements remain unverified.
